t: OMY is a six-joint research robot arm for teaching robots by demonstration.
steps: Order from ROBOTIS US. The leader arm costs about 2,874 US dollars and the full AI kit about 17,249 dollars.
Clear a sturdy table with plenty of space around the arm.
Connect the included 24 V supply and run a network cable to your computer.
Install ROS 2 Jazzy or the Robotis Docker images by following the OMY setup guide.
Load the OMY model in Gazebo and move it in simulation first.
Run the open_manipulator bringup example and move the real arm slowly.
Try leader-follower control with the OMY-L100 leader arm.
Record your first dataset with Physical AI Tools.
meta: Open Code. From $2,874. A few stores.
